items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: He said, 'Well Johnny' Johnny was his — 'Johnny I said, the price I gave you was for eight guys... And we went over there and played great... He paid us, and he had dinner for everybody.'

ctx.x: Yeah Hank O’Neil out of New York. And we were playing this session, they wanted a jam session so we had Dizzy Gillespie and I forget he was a reed player, the tall younger guy, great, great player, Doc Cheatham, you know, who was better than a lot of people gave him credit for. I tuned in Johnny Carson or somebody one night and he’s sitting in with the band. And Dizzy was great. And we were just — but it seemed like there were more black players left over from the big band era. And I had a festival — several…
Milt Hintons, they’re all gone now.
